nodes.description: Public total token supply state variable declared in Token, written in the BitGCoin constructor.
Mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances in StandardToken; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and the constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spending allowances in StandardToken.
Public token name string set by the BitGCoin constructor.
Public uint8 number of decimals set by the BitGCoin constructor.
Public token symbol string set by the BitGCoin constructor.
Public version string 'H0.1' used for human-readable versioning.
Abstract ERC20 declaration balanceOf(address) constant returns (uint256).
Abstract ERC20 declaration transfer(address,uint256) returns (bool).
Abstract ERC20 declaration transferFrom(address,address,uint256) returns (bool).
Abstract ERC20 declaration approve(address,uint256) returns (bool).
Abstract ERC20 declaration allowance(address,address) constant returns (uint256).
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to after checking balances[msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0, then emits Transfer.
Transfers _value from _from to _to using the allowance allowed[_from][msg.sender], decrements balances and allowance, emits Transfer.
Constant getter returning balances[_owner].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Constant getter returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Fallback function that immediately throws if ether is sent to the contract.
Constructor giving the creator all initial tokens and setting totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
Sets the allowance for _spender and then performs an external call to _spender with receiveApproval, reverting on failure.
Low-level external call _spender.call(receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes), msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) to an attacker-controlled address.
Caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance bookkeeping and as the _from argument passed to the external call.

msg.sender can send ether and trigger the BitGCoin fallback, which throws.
transfer._to supplies the destination of the balance update.
transfer._value flows into the balance arithmetic and the Transfer event.
transferFrom._from indexes balances and allowed.
transferFrom._to receives the transferred tokens.
transferFrom._value flows into balances and allowed arithmetic.
balanceOf._owner is used as the key into the balances mapping.
approve._spender is the allowance key written in allowed.
approve._value is stored as the allowance.
allowance._owner is used as the first key into allowed.
allowance._spender is used as the second key into allowed.
Constructor _initialAmount flows into balances[msg.sender] and totalSupply.
Constructor _tokenName flows into the name state variable.
Constructor _decimalUnits flows into the decimals state variable.
Constructor _tokenSymbol flows into the symbol state variable.
approveAndCall._spender is both the allowance key and the external call target.
approveAndCall._value is written to allowed and forwarded to the callee.
approveAndCall._extraData is forwarded verbatim into the external call payload.
msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is written as allowance owner and passed as _from to the external call.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[_to].
transferFrom credits balances[_to] and debits balances[_from].
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
Constructor sets totalSupply = _initialAmount.
Constructor sets balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount.
Constructor writes the name state variable.

Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall executes the low-level external call to an arbitrary _spender with state already updated.
transfer performs the uint256 subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value.
transferFrom performs the uint256 subtraction allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
The unchecked subtraction updates the balances mapping.
The unchecked allowance subtraction updates the allowed mapping.
The callee can re-enter approveAndCall (or the token contract) before the call returns.
The callee can re-enter transferFrom during the external call using its allowance.
